summary: Menus are quicker to use, numbers follow your format, and you can print the audit trail as evidence.

new.title: Menus open on hover
new.text: On a desktop, pointing at a menu opens it and arrow keys move between menus. Touch screens still open a menu with a tap.

new.title: Numbers in your regional format
new.text: Choose Automatic, Danish, English US, English UK or German in the status line. Your browser remembers the choice.

new.title: Print the audit trail as evidence
new.text: Print as evidence on the Audit page prints the filtered trail with who printed it, when and the filter used.

fixes.title: Exports are audited
fixes.text: Exporting or printing the audit trail is now itself recorded in the audit trail.
